entities.summary: Vilard Normcharoen was a Thai Port FC player and one of Thailand's professional beach soccer players who won the award of best goalkeeper in the Beach Soccer World Cup 2002. Vilard made the transition from Futsal to beach soccer and was a great success for the national team and Normcharoen is the most experienced player in the Thailand national beach soccer team.
